evidence_quotes.O: I've been trying to relive the feeling I got shooting Ektachrome and Kodachrome for years. Especially printing on Ilford Pearl paper.
evidence_quotes.C: My focusing method became one of half-pressing the shutter then counting one-mississippi two-mississippi three mississippi then completing the shutter press.
evidence_quotes.E: The first couple of days after I bought this camera, I was shooting along the Chicago river with a group.
evidence_quotes.A: There are several areas where the designers got it almost right, but no cigar.
evidence_quotes.N: I had updated many things at once, including switching to Lion, so I went crazy trying to track down the culprit.
